quests.title: The Rock's Early Story
quests.summary: The Cave Warden at St Michael's wants someone to learn the Rock's first story: the Neanderthals, the caves and the apes.

steps.text: Ask the Curator at the Gibraltar Museum about the Neanderthal skull.
Tell the Cave Warden at St Michael's Cave what you learnt.
Win a fair match against the Ape Keeper at the Apes' Den, then report back to the Cave Warden.

quests.reward: A Siege Cannonball (an Iron charm), three Calentita, two Gibraltar Rosto and standing with the Overseas Territories.
